```diff
+ class ArbitragePathOptimizer {
+     constructor(config) {
+         this.config = config;
+         this.slippageTolerance = 0.005; // 0.5%滑点容忍度
+         this.maxHops = 3; // 最大跳数
+         this.minLiquidityThreshold = ethers.parseEther("1000"); // 最小流动性要求

+ 
+     optimizePath(path, reserves, ethPriceUSD) {
+         const { buyDex, sellDex, loanToken, otherToken } = path;
+         
+         // 检查流动性
+         if (!this.hasSufficientLiquidity(reserves)) {
+             return null;
+         }
+ 
+         // 计算最优闪电贷金额
+         const optimalAmount = this.calculateOptimalAmount(reserves);
+         if (!optimalAmount) return null;
+ 
+         // 计算预期收益
+         const expectedProfit = this.calculateExpectedProfit(optimalAmount, reserves, ethPriceUSD);
+         if (!expectedProfit.isProfitable) return null;
+ 
+         // 添加滑点保护
+         const protectedAmount = this.addSlippageProtection(optimalAmount, reserves);
+         
+         return {
+             ...path,
+             loanAmount: protectedAmount,
+             expectedProfit: expectedProfit.netProfitUSD,
+             confidence: this.calculateConfidence(reserves, expectedProfit)
+         };
+     }
+ 
+     hasSufficientLiquidity(reserves) {
+         return reserves.every(reserve => 
+             reserve >= this.minLiquidityThreshold
+         );
+     }
+ 
+     calculateOptimalAmount(reserves) {
+         try {
+             const [rA, rB, r_B, r_A] = reserves;
+             const FEE = 997n;
+             const FEE_DIVISOR = 1000n;
+             
+             const priceNumerator = r_A * rB;
+             const priceDenominator = r_B * rA;
+ 
+             if(priceDenominator === 0n || priceNumerator <= priceDenominator) {
+                 return 0n;
+             }
+ 
+             const SCALE = ethers.parseEther('1');
+             const scaledNumerator = priceNumerator * SCALE;
+             const priceRatio = scaledNumerator / priceDenominator;
+             const sqrtPriceRatio = sqrt(priceRatio);
+ 
+             const term = (rA * sqrtPriceRatio) / SCALE;
+             const numerator = term - rA;
+             const optimalAmount = (numerator * FEE_DIVISOR) / FEE;
+             
+             return optimalAmount;
+         } catch (e) {
+             return 0n;
+         }
+     }
+ 
+     calculateExpectedProfit(amount, reserves, ethPriceUSD) {
+         try {
+             const [rA, rB, r_B, r_A] = reserves;
+             
+             // 计算买入数量
+             const amountOut = getAmountOutLocal(amount, rA, rB);
+             if (!amountOut) return { isProfitable: false };
+ 
+             // 计算卖出数量
+             const finalAmount = getAmountOutLocal(amountOut, r_B, r_A);
+             if (!finalAmount) return { isProfitable: false };
+ 
+             // 计算毛利润
+             const grossProfit = finalAmount - amount;
+             if (grossProfit <= 0n) return { isProfitable: false };
+ 
+             // 计算闪电贷费用
+             const feeRate = this.config.NETWORK === 'mainnet' ? 9n : 5n;
+             const flashLoanFee = (amount * feeRate) / 10000n;
+             
+             // 计算净利润
+             const netProfitGross = grossProfit - flashLoanFee;
+             const netProfitETH = parseFloat(ethers.formatEther(netProfitGross));
+             const netProfitUSD = netProfitETH * ethPriceUSD;
+ 
+             return {
+                 isProfitable: true,
+                 netProfitUSD,
+                 grossProfit: parseFloat(ethers.formatEther(grossProfit)),
+                 flashLoanFee: parseFloat(ethers.formatEther(flashLoanFee))
+             };
+         } catch (e) {
+             return { isProfitable: false };
+         }
+     }
+ 
+     addSlippageProtection(amount, reserves) {
+         const slippageAmount = (amount * BigInt(Math.floor(this.slippageTolerance * 1000))) / 1000n;
+         return amount - slippageAmount;
+     }
+ 
+     calculateConfidence(reserves, expectedProfit) {
+         // 基于流动性深度和预期收益计算置信度
+         const liquidityScore = this.calculateLiquidityScore(reserves);
+         const profitScore = this.calculateProfitScore(expectedProfit.netProfitUSD);
+         return (liquidityScore + profitScore) / 2;
+     }
+ 
+     calculateLiquidityScore(reserves) {
+         const minReserve = reserves.reduce((min, r) => r < min ? r : min, reserves[0]);
+         const maxReserve = reserves.reduce((max, r) => r > max ? r : max, reserves[0]);
+         return minReserve / maxReserve;
+     }
+ 
+     calculateProfitScore(profitUSD) {
+         const minProfit = this.config.minProfitUSD;
+         const maxProfit = minProfit * 10; // 假设最大利润是最小利润的10倍
+         return Math.min(1, (profitUSD - minProfit) / (maxProfit - minProfit));
+     }
+ }
```

```javascript
class PriceFeedManager {
    // 新增价格历史记录
    this.priceHistory = new Map();
    this.maxHistorySize = 100;
    this.priceVolatilityThreshold = 0.05;

    // 价格稳定性检查
    isPriceStable(newPrice) {
        const history = this.priceHistory.get('ETH') || [];
        if (history.length === 0) return true;
        const lastPrice = history[history.length - 1];
        const priceChange = Math.abs(newPrice - lastPrice) / lastPrice;
        return priceChange <= this.priceVolatilityThreshold;
    }
}
```

2. 套利路径优化：
```javascript
class ArbitragePathOptimizer {
    constructor(config) {
        this.slippageTolerance = 0.005; // 0.5%滑点容忍度
        this.maxHops = 3; // 最大跳数
        this.minLiquidityThreshold = ethers.parseEther("1000");
    }

    optimizePath(path, reserves, ethPriceUSD) {
        // 检查流动性
        if (!this.hasSufficientLiquidity(reserves)) return null;
        
        // 计算最优金额
        const optimalAmount = this.calculateOptimalAmount(reserves);
        if (!optimalAmount) return null;

        // 添加滑点保护
        const protectedAmount = this.addSlippageProtection(optimalAmount, reserves);
        
        return {
            ...path,
            loanAmount: protectedAmount,
            confidence: this.calculateConfidence(reserves, expectedProfit)
        };
    }
}
```

3. 收益计算优化：
```javascript
calculateExpectedProfit(amount, reserves, ethPriceUSD) {
    // 计算买入数量
    const amountOut = getAmountOutLocal(amount, rA, rB);
    if (!amountOut) return { isProfitable: false };

    // 计算卖出数量
    const finalAmount = getAmountOutLocal(amountOut, r_B, r_A);
    if (!finalAmount) return { isProfitable: false };

    // 计算毛利润
    const grossProfit = finalAmount - amount;
    if (grossProfit <= 0n) return { isProfitable: false };

    // 计算闪电贷费用
    const feeRate = this.config.NETWORK === 'mainnet' ? 9n : 5n;
    const flashLoanFee = (amount * feeRate) / 10000n;
    
    // 计算净利润
    const netProfitGross = grossProfit - flashLoanFee;
    const netProfitETH = parseFloat(ethers.formatEther(netProfitGross));
    const netProfitUSD = netProfitETH * ethPriceUSD;

    return {
        isProfitable: true,
        netProfitUSD,
        grossProfit: parseFloat(ethers.formatEther(grossProfit)),
        flashLoanFee: parseFloat(ethers.formatEther(flashLoanFee))
    };
}
```

```diff
+     // 【新增】价格权重计算
+     calculatePriceWeights(prices) {
+         const n = prices.length;
+         const weights = new Array(n);
+         let sum = 0;
+         
+         // 使用指数衰减权重
+         for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
+             weights[i] = Math.exp(-0.5 * (n - i - 1));
+             sum += weights[i];
+         }
+         
+         // 归一化权重
+         return weights.map(w => w / sum);
+     }
```

```diff
+ 
+             // 执行交易
+             const result = await this.sendTransaction(transaction);
+             
+             // 更新交易历史
+             this.updateTransactionHistory(txHash, 'success', result);
+             
+             return result;
+         } catch (error) {
+             this.updateTransactionHistory(txHash, 'failed', error);
+             throw error;
+         }
+     }
+ 
+     validateTransaction(transaction) {
+         return (
+             transaction.to &&
+             transaction.data &&
+             transaction.gasLimit &&
+             transaction.maxFeePerGas &&
+             transaction.maxPriorityFeePerGas
+         );
+     }
+ 
+     async estimateGasWithBuffer(transaction) {
+         const estimate = await this.dependencies.provider.estimateGas(transaction);
+         return (estimate * 120n) / 100n; // 20% buffer
+     }
+ 
+     updateTransactionHistory(txHash, status, result) {
+         const history = this.transactionHistory.get(txHash);
+         if (history) {
+             history.status = status;
+             history.result = result;
+             history.updatedAt = Date.now();
+         }
+     }
+ }
```

1. 价格管理系统增强：
```javascript
class PriceFeedManager {
    constructor(dependencies) {
        // 新增企业级监控参数
        this.lastSuccessfulUpdate = 0;
        this.consecutiveFailures = 0;
        this.maxConsecutiveFailures = 5;
        this.emergencyMode = false;
        this.priceAlertThreshold = 0.15; // 15%价格波动告警阈值
    }

    // 新增价格健康监控
    async monitorPriceHealth() {
        const timeSinceLastUpdate = now - this.lastSuccessfulUpdate;
        if (timeSinceLastUpdate > this.updateInterval * 2) {
            this.consecutiveFailures++;
            if (this.consecutiveFailures >= this.maxConsecutiveFailures) {
                this.emergencyMode = true;
            }
        }
    }
}
```

2. 企业级价格异常检测：
```javascript
detectPriceAnomaly(newPrice) {
    const history = this.priceHistory.get('ETH') || [];
    if (history.length < 2) return false;

    const recentPrices = history.slice(-5);
    const avgPrice = recentPrices.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / recentPrices.length;
    const priceChange = Math.abs(newPrice - avgPrice) / avgPrice;

    if (priceChange > this.priceAlertThreshold) {
        console.error(`[价格监控] 警告: 检测到异常价格波动 ${(priceChange * 100).toFixed(2)}%`);
        return true;
    }
    return false;
}
```

3. 企业级备用价格策略：
```javascript
getEnterpriseFallbackPrice() {
    const history = this.priceHistory.get('ETH') || [];
    if (history.length === 0) {
        return this.getEmergencyPrice();
    }

    // 使用复杂的加权平均算法
    const recentPrices = history.slice(-10);
    const weights = this.calculatePriceWeights(recentPrices);
    const weightedPrice = recentPrices.reduce((sum, price, i) => sum + price * weights[i], 0);
    
    return weightedPrice;
}
```

4. 新增企业级交易执行器：
```javascript
class TransactionExecutor {
    constructor(dependencies, config) {
        this.transactionHistory = new Map();
        this.maxRetries = 3;
        this.retryDelay = 1000;
        this.gasPriceBuffer = 1.1; // 10% gas价格缓冲
    }

    async executeTransaction(transaction, blockNumber) {
        // 交易验证和Gas估算
        if (!this.validateTransaction(transaction)) {
            throw new Error('Invalid transaction parameters');
        }

        const gasEstimate = await this.estimateGasWithBuffer(transaction);
        transaction.gasLimit = gasEstimate;

        // 执行交易并记录历史
        const result = await this.sendTransaction(transaction);
        this.updateTransactionHistory(txHash, 'success', result);
        
        return result;
    }
}
```

5. 改进的Gas成本计算：
```javascript
if (txReceipt) {
    try {
        const gasUsed = txReceipt.gasUsed;
        const gasPrice = txReceipt.effectiveGasPrice || feeData.lastBaseFeePerGas;
        
        if (!gasPrice) {
            throw new Error('无法获取有效的gas价格');
        }

        const gasCost = gasUsed * gasPrice;
        
        // 使用价格管理器获取ETH价格

        if (!DataValidator.isValidPrice(ethPriceUSD)) {
            throw new Error('无法获取有效的ETH价格');

        gasSpentTodayUSD += costUSD;

        console.error("  - Gas成本核算失败:", e.message);
    }
}
```

```javascript
async function updateReserves() {

                this.safeGetReserves(pair.contract, pair)
```
